basics.name: Ed Grzetich
basics.label: Senior Technical Writer
basics.summary: Senior technical writer with over 10 years of experience building developer documentation for cloud, API, and platform products. At AWS, owned API and SDK reference documentation for developer-facing services, working directly from source and OpenAPI specifications. Author of Tokens Not Jokin' (Leanpub, 2026), a controlled empirical study of over 21,000 integration tests measuring how documentation format affects AI-generated code quality across four models and four formats. Headline finding: format explains more than 10x the variance in output quality compared to model choice, making documentation structure a product decision, not a style preference. Comfortable reading TypeScript and Python source, building documentation tooling with Python, and shipping docs that serve both human developers and the AI tools they increasingly work through.

work.name: AWS
work.summary: Owned API and SDK reference documentation for developer-facing AWS services, translating engineering source and specifications into accurate, complete reference material at scale. Partnered with service teams to document new features from design through launch, maintaining consistency of voice and structure across a large docs surface used by millions of developers. Worked in docs-as-code workflows with version control, review pipelines, and automated builds.

work.name: Mastercard
work.summary: Developed B2B content strategy for communicating technical requirements to global financial partners. Designed modular, reusable content systems using DITA XML, structuring content for consistency and single-source reuse across partner-facing deliverables.

work.name: General Dynamics Mission Systems
work.summary: Led a remote documentation team supporting NASA's Space Network Ground Segment Sustainment program. Owned documentation quality, standards, and delivery for a complex technical program; the team received formal NASA recognition for documentation quality.
